details: The model decided to submit its finding: evidence weak, citing passage 1A:22 sentence 1; passage 1A:22 sentence 7.

steps.title: Model call 1 for rational capital allocation: 2,401 tokens in, 203 out, ~$0.0009 at paid rates

steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 1 problem in 11 items
details: The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation rationale: it says "debt repayments ($702 million)", which the quoted sentences don't show.

steps.title: Critic sent 1 finding back for repair
details: Rational capital allocation: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).

steps.title: Rationale rewrite for rational capital allocation: 397 tokens in, 54 out, ~$0.0002 at paid rates
details: The model saw only the question, the verdict and the quoted sentences, and rewrote the rationale to say no more than they show.

New rationale: The company maintains a dividend policy to meet IRC requirements while retaining cash for capital deployment and investment activities. Additionally, the filing quantifies cash investments in unconsolidated entities for property acquisitions, development, and venture debt repayment.
